goalZh: 会读年份,用 be born 说出生的年份、地点和日期,简单介绍生肖
canDoZh: 能说出自己哪年、在哪儿出生,并用英语简单介绍中国的生肖

newItems.noteZh: 一定要有 be:I was born in 2006.(不说 I born… 也不说 I am born…);问 When were you born?。
生肖年都这么说:the Year of the + 动物,前面加 the;the Year of the Rooster(鸡年)、the Year of the Goat(羊年)。
the Chinese zodiac 是中国的十二生肖(西方的 zodiac 指十二星座);z 要带声,重音在前 ZO-diac。
重音在前 AN-i-mal,a 读 /æ/;twelve animals(十二种动物)。
也叫 Lunar New Year 或 Spring Festival;按农历算,每年在一月底到二月中。
生肖里的“鸡”英语叫 Rooster;oo 读长音 /uː/;鸡肉是第 4 单元的 chicken。
ou 读 /ʌ/,结尾 ng 是 /ŋ/;You're so young!(你好年轻!)第 2 单元的 younger 是它的比较级。
生肖里的“羊”英语一般叫 Goat(也有人说 Sheep);oa 读 /oʊ/,词尾 t 收住。

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: So, when were you born, you guys?
lines.zh: (交换完礼物,大家聊起年龄)对了,你们都是哪年出生的?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I was born in 2006, in Chengdu. That's the Year of the Dog!
lines.zh: 我 2006 年生在成都。那年是狗年!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: The Year of the Dog? What does that mean?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: It's the Chinese zodiac. Every year has an animal.
lines.zh: 是中国的生肖。每一年都有一个动物。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: The year starts on Chinese New Year, in January or February.
lines.zh: 生肖年从春节开始算,春节在一月或者二月。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Cool! I was born in 2005. What am I?
lines.zh: 酷!我是 2005 年出生的。我属什么?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: 2005 was the Year of the Rooster.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Me too! I was born on December 28th, 2005. That's in four days!
lines.zh: 我也是!我是 2005 年 12 月 28 日出生的。还有四天就到了!

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: 2006? Lei, you're so young! I was born in 2003.
lines.zh: 2006 年?磊,你好年轻啊!我是 2003 年出生的。

questions.prompt: 磊是哪年出生的?属什么?
questions.explainZh: I was born in 2006, in Chengdu. That's the Year of the Dog!(属鸡的是艾米和索菲亚,属羊的是马库斯。)

questions.prompt: 磊说生肖年从什么时候开始算?
questions.explainZh: The year starts on Chinese New Year, in January or February.

options: 索菲亚的生日已经过了
questions.explainZh: 艾米 2005 年出生,磊说 2005 was the Year of the Rooster.;索菲亚说 Me too!,她也是 2005 年出生,生日还有四天。马库斯 2003 年出生,比磊大。

grammar.bodyZh: 英语年份一般两位两位地读:1998 = nineteen ninety-eight,2026 = twenty twenty-six。2000 到 2009 年常读成 two thousand…:2003 = two thousand three,2006 = two thousand six(口语也说 twenty oh-six,这里的 0 读 oh,第 1 单元学过)。2010 年以后两种都有,两位两位读更常见:2015 = twenty fifteen。中国学生容易一个数字一个数字地读(two zero zero six),英语里年份不这么读。发音:thousand /ˈθaʊzənd/,th 咬舌,ou 读 /aʊ/,s 读 /z/。

examples.zh: 我 2006 年出生(2006 读 two thousand six)。

examples.text: 2005 was the Year of the Rooster.
examples.zh: 2005 年是鸡年(2005 读 two thousand five)。

grammar.bodyZh: 英语说“出生”用 be born,一定要有 be,过去的事用 was / were:I was born in 2006.(不说 I born in 2006.,也不说 I am born in 2006.)。问别人:When were you born? / Where were you born?。介词:年份、月份、城市用 in(in 2006 / in December / in Chengdu),具体哪一天用 on(on April 18th / on December 28th)。说生肖:I was born in the Year of the Dog.。

examples.text: When were you born? — I was born in 2006, in Chengdu.
examples.zh: 你哪年出生的?——2006 年,在成都。
索菲亚是 12 月 28 日出生的。
